orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Lumen "Ion Drive: Halo", a hull mount (outward is up): the Glimmer ion rings and spine plus a ring of light round the spine (cyan, magenta nodes, a glint that runs round it) and a soft ring of light in the glow; inside the Glimmer core with a second ring of light round the lens crystal. Damaged: the middle ring has slipped out of line and cracked, the halo ring is broken and arcs jump the gap, the lens crystal is cracked and flickers. Disabled: the top ring snapped half off and hanging, the halo ring broken and dark, the lens shattered, every line dead. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
